rationale: With only 6 minutes remaining in the trading session and the stock showing a recent rejection at the $31.00 level with increased selling volume on the most recent candle, the probability of reaching the $31.30 take-profit target before the mandatory market-on-close liquidation is low. Closing now captures the current unrealized gain and eliminates the risk of a late-session fade or slippage during the automatic end-of-day liquidation.
